import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
import sqlite3

class City:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        self.resources = {"food": 0, "water": 0, "energy": 0}
        self.buildings = []
        self.citizens = []

class Game:

        self.resource_entry = tk.Entry(self.resource_frame)

        self.building_label = tk.Label(self.building_frame, text="Buildings:")

        self.building_entry = tk.Entry(self.building_frame)

        self.citizen_label = tk.Label(self.citizen_frame, text="Citizens:")
        self.citizen_label.pack()

        self.citizen_entry = tk.Entry(self.citizen_frame)
        self.citizen_entry.pack()

        self.update_button = tk.Button(self.resource_frame, text="Update Resources", command=self.update_resources)
        self.update_button.pack()

        self.build_button = tk.Button(self.building_frame, text="Build Building", command=self.build_building)
        self.build_button.pack()

        self.citizen_button = tk.Button(self.citizen_frame, text="Add Citizen", command=self.add_citizen)
        self.citizen_button.pack()

    def update_resources(self):
        resource = self.resource_entry.get()
        self.city.resources[resource] += 1
        self.resource_label.config(text=f"Resources: {self.city.resources}")

    def build_building(self):
        building = self.building_entry.get()
        self.city.buildings.append(building)
        self.building_label.config(text=f"Buildings: {self.city.buildings}")

    def add_citizen(self):
        citizen = self.citizen_entry.get()
        self.city.citizens.append(citizen)
        self.citizen_label.config(text=f"Citizens: {self.city.citizens}")

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    game = Game()
    game.run()
